text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the academy's sponsored Fan 
Interaction Event. I was put in charge of 
running the event, but... right before 
opening, an unexpected problem arose.
choice_data_list: What?! We're short on staff?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The staff member tasked with managing 
the venue suddenly couldn't make it... 
We're currently looking for a replacement, 
but...
choice_data_list:
Understood. I'll help look for someone 
too!

Understood. I'll help look for someone 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I contacted several event agencies, but 
same-day dispatch is impossible. With 
crowds incoming, our current manpower is 
definitely not going to cut it...
choice_data_list:
(Worst case, we might have to consider 
canceling...)

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: You. What are you doing?
choice_data_list: ! Orfèvre...

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Do not display such a gloomy face before 
my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her words are unreasonable... her 
unwavering demeanor is so reassuring that 
I end up explaining the whole situation.
choice_data_list: ...Umm, the truth is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I explain, Orfèvre listens in silence, 
fixing her sharp gaze right through me.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: ...How unsightly.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
However—such unsightly behavior from you 
impugns my own honor.
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Someone, attend to me.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre's Subject A
text_block_list.text:
—Present! Lady Orfèvre, I have arrived 
before you.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Gather my subjects. —Inform my elder 
sister to make haste as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Should there be any others of use, I shall 
summon them myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At Orfèvre's imperial command, everyone 
around immediately sprang into action.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The venue entrance is this way! Please do 
not spill into the road and remain in 
line!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre's Subject B
text_block_list.text:
I'm holding up the placard~! Please follow 
this line~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, thank you for coming. If you'd 
like, please take a flyer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, baggage inspection time. Show 
me what you got, let's see if there's 
anything dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—It seems a child got lost in the venue. 
Orfe, who shall we entrust them to?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to Golshi. She is adept at 
dealing with young children.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under her supreme command, the flow of 
visitors proceeded smoothly without a 
hitch.
choice_data_list: (Incredible...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: The stage is set.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Now, ensure this event turns into a 
spectacle worthy of my orchestration.
choice_data_list: ...! Yeah, of course!
...! Yeah, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Determined to answer Orfèvre's 
expectations, I dash around coordinating 
with staff and verifying schedules. As a 
result—the event was a roaring success.

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Today's event has concluded. Please watch 
your step on your way home—"
choice_data_list: Orfèvre!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Ah, you.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for today...!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Pay it no mind. It is merely the duty of a 
King.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so... my gratitude toward her knows 
no bounds. Yet at the same time, a single 
question surfaces.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
However—such unsightly behavior from you 
impugns my own honor.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: What are you staring at?
choice_data_list: Umm... can I ask just one thing?
Umm... can I ask just one thing?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: I permit it.
choice_data_list:
Why would my unsightly failure affect your 
honor...?

Why would my unsightly failure affect your 
honor...?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: A foolish question.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
A disgraceful display from a subject 
tarnishes the King's glory.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: That is all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She treated me as her 'subject' like it 
was second nature. And yet...
choice_data_list:
(What is this feeling... this strange 
exhilaration...?!)

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Judging by that look on your face, if you 
have something to say, speak.
choice_data_list: —It is an absolute honor...!

Umm, well... since when was I your 
subject?

Umm, well... since when was I your 
subject?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Judging by that look on your face, if you 
have something to say, speak.
choice_data_list: —It is an absolute honor...!

Umm, well... since when was I your 
subject?

Umm, well... since when was I your 
subject?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —Good.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Continue to devote yourself diligently as 
my subject hereafter.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: You simpleton.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: From the very moment I decreed it so.
